plugins.name: paywhere-smb
plugins.description: Small-business finance workflows run against your bank through the Paywhere connector plus QuickBooks (read-only), Gmail (drafts only) and Google Calendar: pay bills behind one approval, payroll headroom, the sales-tax reserve, sweeping spare cash to savings, vendor payment timing, profit-to-cash bridge, big-purchase decision, credit readiness, tax-season prep, and two scheduled agents. Six tool calls or fewer per skill; payments stage as proposals approved on the bank's /confirm page.

plugins.name: paywhere-eng-workflow
plugins.description: Shared Paywhere engineering workflow: Linear-ticket-driven branch/PR flow, dependency refresh, TeamCity reconcile, production cuts, and Terraform drift triage + gated apply. Parameterised per-repo via .claude/eng-workflow.json.
